cards.name: Fire!
cards.text: Your most-built property loses 1 level, unless you have an Insured marker. If you have no buildings, nothing happens.

cards.name: Recession
cards.text: Every player pays 10% of their cash to the bank, except whoever has the least cash.

cards.name: Housing Boom
cards.text: Every player collects $50 for each hotel or skyscraper they own.

cards.name: Lottery
cards.text: Everyone who can puts in $20 and rolls 1 die. The highest roll takes the pot. Reroll ties.

cards.name: Rush Hour
cards.text: Every player moves back 2 spaces. Nobody resolves the space they land on, and nobody collects GO.

cards.name: Road Work
cards.text: Next turn you roll only 1 die, unless you spend 1 Momentum token.

cards.name: Momentum Surge
cards.text: Everyone gains 1 Momentum token. You gain 2.

cards.name: Property Reassessment
cards.text: Pay $25 per house and $100 per hotel or skyscraper you own.

cards.name: Advance to GO
cards.text: Move to GO and collect GO effects.

cards.name: Emergency Session
cards.text: Start an Emergency Council session with you setting the agenda. (The City Council arrives in a later phase, so nothing happens yet.)
